map.title: MAP 1 · MONUMENT
map.intro: Dummy Corporation welcomes you off the factory floor. Your colleague learns from every crash; keep finding new ways.

tiles.title: The welcome wall
tiles.newIdea: Controls: walk into the red car's path.
tiles.tale: Fresh off the factory floor, you are ready to do some damage. Step into the red car's path.
tiles.hint: Walk into the red car's lane as it arrives.

tiles.title: The podium bridge
tiles.newIdea: The car learns once: it brakes for a dummy in its lane.
tiles.tale: Battery 1 is fitted. After one crash the red car brakes for lanes, so dash in from the side.
tiles.hint: Stay out of its lane; dash in as it rolls past.

tiles.title: The LED drum
tiles.newIdea: Side sensors: it notices a dummy waiting beside the road.
tiles.tale: The LED drum lights each bend. Side sensors now watch the kerb, so approach from the plinth instead.
tiles.hint: Climb the plinth; drop onto the car.

tiles.title: The portal tower
tiles.newIdea: Roof lidar: the raised plinth no longer hides you.
tiles.tale: The road runs through the portal tower. Roof lidar now sees the plinth, so wait behind cover.
tiles.hint: Wait behind cover; dash out as it passes.

tiles.title: The monument
tiles.newIdea: Street cameras: cover no longer hides you from the car.
tiles.tale: The plaque reads ZERO ACCIDENTS: a target, not a record. Street cameras now see behind cover.
tiles.hint: Cover is useless now; strike from beyond its field.

tiles.title: The neon shops
tiles.newIdea: DUCK: hide behind low planters once cones stop working.
tiles.tale: The neon shops sell nothing. The red car now stops for cones, so duck behind planters and wait.
tiles.hint: Duck behind a planter; spring out as it passes.

tiles.title: The stacked cubes
tiles.newIdea: Crash memory: it watches every spot where it hit you.
tiles.tale: The stacked cubes rose one budget at a time. Crash spots are now remembered; choose a fresh one.
tiles.hint: Take each hit somewhere new; it watches old spots.

tiles.title: The LED canyon
tiles.newIdea: The search: lose its sight and it hunts your last spot.
tiles.tale: Two screens advertise to each other all night. Seen then hidden, you get searched for. Crawl away.
tiles.hint: Stay out of sight cones; crawl clear of its search.

tiles.title: The LED gateway
tiles.newIdea: Two-way traffic: white cars that never learn give moving cover.
tiles.tale: The gateway thanks every car for driving safely. White cars never learn, so hide behind them. Certification awaits.
tiles.hint: Walk behind a white car; strike the red one.

rationale: Only the validator error was fixed: tile 9's objective label is now four words (FOUR HITS, WHITE-CAR COVER), within the five-word limit. Everything else is unchanged.
